messages.content: Build a premium cybersecurity SaaS website for Sentinel, a threat-detection platform for mid-size companies. Dark, serious, technical.

Create a dark, technical SaaS marketing site for Sentinel, a threat-detection platform for mid-size companies. The tone is serious and precise: no stock-photo hackers, no glowing padlocks.

ART DIRECTION
- Palette: near-black background #0B0E14, panels #121722, text #E6E9EF, muted text #8B94A7, one accent only: signal green #3DDC97 for status, focus and the primary CTA. No gradients on text.
- Typography: a grotesque sans (Inter or Geist) for UI and headings, tabular monospace (JetBrains Mono) for numbers, logs and code. Type scale 14 / 16 / 20 / 28 / 40 / 64px, headings weight 600, letter-spacing -0.02em above 28px.
- Grid: 12 columns, 1200px max container, 24px gutters. Hairline dividers (1px, #1E2536) instead of drop shadows.

STRUCTURE (single landing page + /pricing + /docs entry)
1. Navigation: compact 56px bar, logo left, 4 links, 'Book a demo' as a solid accent button, 'Sign in' as text. Sticky, background blur on scroll.
2. Hero: two columns 7/5. Left: headline max 8 words, one-sentence value proposition, two CTAs. Right: a live-looking detection console rendered in HTML (monospace event rows appearing one by one, 400ms apart, no video).
3. Proof strip: 5 grayscale client logos, single row, 40px height, wraps to 2 rows below 768px.
4. Capabilities: 3 cards (Detect, Investigate, Respond), each with a monospace metric line and a 2-line description. Cards share equal height; hover lifts 2px and brightens the border to the accent.
5. How it works: numbered 3-step horizontal timeline that becomes vertical under 1024px.
6. Integrations: 8 icon tiles in a 4x2 grid, 2 columns on mobile.
7. Pricing teaser: 3 tiers, middle tier highlighted with the accent border; link to /pricing.
8. Footer: 4 columns, SOC 2 and GDPR badges as plain text with icons, legal links.

RESPONSIVE
Breakpoints 640 / 768 / 1024 / 1280px. Hero stacks under 1024px with the console below the copy; body text never below 16px on mobile; touch targets minimum 44px.

MOTION
Only two kinds: fade-up on section entry (20px, 500ms, ease-out, once) and the console event feed. Respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling both.

ACCESSIBILITY & PERFORMANCE
WCAG AA contrast on every text/background pair (check the muted text on panels), visible 2px accent focus rings, semantic landmarks, skip link. Self-hosted fonts with font-display: swap, no third-party scripts above the fold, LCP target under 2.0s on 4G.

COMPONENTS TO IMPLEMENT
Button (solid, outline, text), NavBar, ConsoleFeed, CapabilityCard, Timeline, PricingTier, LogoStrip, Footer — each with hover, focus, disabled and loading states.
Site vitrine pour Maison Aubrac, une boulangerie artisanale à Toulouse. Pain au levain, viennoiseries, commande en ligne pour retrait. Ambiance chaleureuse.

Create a warm, tactile storefront website for Maison Aubrac, an artisan sourdough bakery in Toulouse, with online ordering for in-store pickup. Everything should feel baked, not designed: paper, flour, crust.

ART DIRECTION
- Palette: warm cream background #F6EFE3, deep crust brown #4A2C1A for text, rye #8C5A3C for secondary text, one accent: burnt orange #D9622B for CTAs and prices. Grain texture at 3% opacity on the page background only.
- Typography: a high-contrast serif (Fraunces or Playfair Display) for headings with optical size on, a humanist sans (Source Sans 3) for body. Scale 16 / 18 / 22 / 32 / 48 / 72px; headings in weight 500, italic for product names.
- Imagery: full-bleed photographs with natural light, warm white balance, no filters. Rounded corners 8px on cards, 0px on full-bleed images.
- Grid: 12 columns desktop, 1120px container, generous vertical rhythm (section padding 96px desktop, 56px mobile).

PAGES
1. Home: hero with a single photograph of the bread board, headline in serif (max 6 words), one CTA 'Commander pour retrait'. Below: today's bakes (horizontal scroll of 6 product cards on mobile, 3-column grid on desktop), opening hours block in monospace-like tabular figures, a short founder note with portrait, map embed with the address in text for accessibility.
2. La carte: product grid filterable by Pains / Viennoiseries / Pâtisseries. Each card: photo 4:5, name, weight, price with tabular figures, 'Ajouter' button. Show allergens on a tap/hover disclosure, never in a tooltip alone.
3. Commande: cart drawer from the right (480px, full width on mobile), pickup slot picker with 15-minute steps, closed days disabled, order summary sticky on desktop.
4. La maison: story in two columns, timeline of the year's seasonal breads, team photos.
5. Contact and legal pages.

INTERACTIONS & MOTION
Product cards: on hover the photo scales 1.03 over 600ms with an ease-out curve; add-to-cart shows a 2-second inline confirmation instead of a toast. Page transitions: none. Disable all scale effects under prefers-reduced-motion.

RESPONSIVE
Breakpoints 600 / 900 / 1200px. Header collapses to logo + cart + menu button under 900px; hours block becomes a two-row table on mobile.

ACCESSIBILITY & PERFORMANCE
AA contrast (rye on cream passes for text 18px+, use crust brown below), all products with alt text describing the bread not the photo, slot picker fully keyboard-operable with a visible focus ring in burnt orange. Images served as AVIF/WebP with explicit width/height, hero preloaded, no layout shift on the hours block. French as the only language, lang="fr".
Portfolio for a documentary photographer named Lior Adan. Minimal, editorial, black and white work, lots of whitespace.

Create a minimal editorial portfolio for Lior Adan, a documentary photographer working in black and white. The site is a quiet gallery: the photographs carry the page, the interface disappears.

ART DIRECTION
- Palette: paper white #FAFAF8, ink #111111, one grey #9A9A96 for captions and metadata. No accent colour anywhere; links are underlined ink text.
- Typography: a neo-grotesque (Neue Haas Grotesk or Söhne alternative like Inter) at 15px body, 13px captions, 11px uppercase labels with 0.08em tracking. Series titles at 32px weight 400. Never bold.
- Layout: asymmetric editorial grid on a 12-column base. Images placed at 5, 7 or 12 columns wide, never centred; vertical spacing between photographs 120px desktop, 64px mobile. Left margin 8.33% on desktop for all text.

PAGES
1. Index (home): a vertical list of series titles in one column, each with year and location in grey; hovering a title reveals a single representative image fixed on the right half of the viewport (desktop only). On mobile the list is plain and taps navigate.
2. Series page: a vertical sequence of photographs, one per row, with captions below in grey; a sticky, 40px-tall header showing series title and progress (e.g. 07 / 24). Keyboard arrows move between images; no lightbox.
3. About: a single column of text at 7 columns wide, one portrait, a short list of publications and exhibitions in a two-column definition list.
4. Contact: email as text link, Instagram, no form.

INTERACTION & MOTION
Images fade from 0 to 1 over 400ms when they enter the viewport, once, no translation. Hover states are limited to underline thickening (1px to 2px). Under prefers-reduced-motion, images are simply visible.

RESPONSIVE
Breakpoints 720 / 1080px. Under 1080px the hover-preview is removed and the index list widens to full width; images become 100% width with 24px side margins.

ACCESSIBILITY & PERFORMANCE
Every photograph has a descriptive alt text written as a caption (place, year, what is depicted), skip link to the series list, focus ring 2px ink offset 4px. Images in responsive srcset up to 2400px wide, greyscale JPEGs at quality 82, lazy-loaded except the first two of each series; fonts self-hosted; CLS zero via reserved aspect-ratio boxes.

COMPONENTS
SeriesIndexItem (with preview binding), Figure (image + caption), ProgressHeader, DefinitionList, TextLink.
